title: Article 49 — Protection of monuments and places and objects of national importance

content.overview: Article 49 directs the State to protect every monument or place or object of artistic or historic interest, declared by or under law made by Parliament to be of national importance, from spoliation, disfigurement, destruction, removal, disposal or export.

sections.heading: Directive content
sections.body: Cultural-heritage protection; primary duties flow through heritage legislation. Related: Art 37.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Implement through statute or scheme. Article 37 bars treating this as a freestanding justiciable right.
